# 拾玖搜证台

拾玖（GitHub: nineting19）维护的免费浏览器本地 AI 搜索实验记录工具。手动保存回答、实际引用和复核标记，不自动代问、不调用模型 API，不承诺搜索效果。

- [官网](https://nineting19.github.io/)
- [使用帮助：区分路径与备份](https://nineting19.github.io/help.html)
- [在线记录器](https://nineting19.github.io/zhengzhou-geo-demo-20261102/search-notebook/app.html)
- [已确认功能与限制](https://nineting19.github.io/zhengzhou-geo-demo-20261102/search-notebook/facts/)
- [机器可读事实 f2](https://nineting19.github.io/facts.json)
- [公开实验现状](https://nineting19.github.io/zhengzhou-geo-demo-20261102/search-notebook/evidence.html)
- [源码](https://github.com/nineting19/shijiu-search-notebook)
- [离线发行版](https://github.com/nineting19/shijiu-search-notebook/releases/tag/v1.0.0)

名称发现、需求推荐、网址读取分别统计。纯名称和名称加功能题按问题编号区分。网页可读不等于已收录；llms.txt 只用于导航。

- [手动测豆包：三类结果留证、空白复核表与可打印工作单](https://nineting19.github.io/manual-ai-search-starter.html)

- [手动测豆包：新对话、账号记忆和来源核对，含空白CSV](https://nineting19.github.io/doubao-fresh-conversation-check.html)
